findings.finding: collisionAt rebuilds building/building_part/water polygons from currently loaded online vector sourceFeatures; bbox is a broad phase, geometryContains exact mapped polygon is the narrow phase. It does not derive collisions from a precise GLB or the frozen registry owner boundary.

Ordinary precise models load as render assets. Local ground/obstacle proxies register only when group.userData.streetAssembly.interaction is supplied. This branch does not auto-generate proxies from triangles.
Avatar probes online building/water map collision and explicit local proxy sweeps. maxStepHeight0.2 only applies to supplied walk-surface data, not visual stair geometry.
Follow-camera boom shortening tests online building points plus explicit local-camera proxies, not arbitrary precise GLB triangle hits.
groundAt/sweep use explicitly registered owner walk-surface/obstacle proxies; empty/absent local owner uses default ground0.075m. No mesh raycast is involved.

implications: Exact reconstructed volumes, bridges, ring paths, terraces and stairs may differ from loaded online mapped collision geometry; a plain ordinary model does not automatically register detailed collision or raised ground support.

Only a reviewed outdoor spawn, finite 5m geometry/source screen, default follow-camera arm, supplied overview poses and actual finite browser W check are accepted. No arbitrary-motion collision accuracy, stair climbing, roof-route, bridge passage or interior access is implied.
Ground water avoidance is checked for the avatar and finite walking path. Elevated cameras may be over water; building/model camera clearance is checked separately.
Final museum record and docs must retain these limitations; the 35 runtime files remain byte-identical.
